mapping.title: Mapping
mapping.description: JSON object {target: column|null}; omit to use the suggestion

metadata_columns.title: Metadata Columns
metadata_columns.description: JSON list of columns kept as case metadata

CaseEditOut.title: CaseEditOut
CaseEditOut.description: Every edit creates a new dataset version (spec §10.2).

quality_note.title: Quality Note
quality_note.default: Quality = unweighted mean of the model's per-metric means across the selected metrics and engines. Use it for ranking at a glance; compare individual metrics before deciding.

ConnectorTestIn.title: ConnectorTestIn
ConnectorTestIn.description: Test a draft or saved config. With connector_id and no auth_value, the stored secret is used.

note.title: Note
note.default: Heuristic estimate from input lengths and per-metric call counts; actual cost is measured.

MetricAggregate.title: MetricAggregate
MetricAggregate.description: One metric on one engine across repeats. Errors are counted, never averaged.

MetricSummaryRow.title: MetricSummaryRow
MetricSummaryRow.description: Per metric × engine across the run's results. Per-result values are the mean over repeats.

ProviderOut.title: ProviderOut
ProviderOut.description: Keys are write-only: only a masked hint is ever returned.

RagConnectorPatch.title: RagConnectorPatch
RagConnectorPatch.description: Full replacement of the config; omit auth_value to keep the stored secret.

RegressionMetric.title: RegressionMetric
RegressionMetric.description:
baseline_mean / candidate_mean_paired / pass rates *_paired: over paired cases (what the delta uses).
candidate_mean / candidate_pass_rate: over the whole candidate run (what min_score / min_pass_rate use).

note.title: Note
note.default: Regression = drop beyond the tolerance and, with 3+ repeats in both runs, beyond one standard error of judge noise. Tunable defaults, not statistical guarantees.
